title: a launch line without --build, --brief, --mode or --worktree is denied, naming the flag that is missing
source: intended: TS-ODDITIES H3 and docs/decisions.md A2 (defect N-29): the dispatcher's launch line is complete
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES H3, owner decision, defect N-29, with --worktree required by the owner's answer on A2). The dispatch guard requires --build, --brief, --mode and --worktree, and denies a line that lacks one with `<flag> is required`, checking them in that order. The TS binary allows a bare launch (an empty flag list passes) and denies the other rows for another reason, so the reason text FAILS on TS.
